Imports System Imports System.Collections.Generic Imports System.Data Imports System.Data.Common Imports System.Globalization Imports System.IO Imports System.Linq Imports Microsoft.VisualBasic Imports OneStream.Finance.Database Imports OneStream.Finance.Engine Imports OneStream.Shared.Common Imports OneStream.Shared.Database Imports OneStream.Shared.Engine Imports OneStream.Shared.Wcf Imports OneStream.Stage.Database Imports OneStream.Stage.Engine
Namespace Workspace.__WsNamespacePrefix.__WsAssemblyName Public Class GBL_Helpers
#Region "Shared utilities (parsed out of app-local RP_Utilities - generic, no RP domain)"
' Returns the two-digit year for a given WFTime / fiscal year string. ' Input: "2025" -> Returns: "25" ' Parsed out of the app-local Get_WFTime_YY; pure string op, no RP dependency. Public Shared Function GetWFTime_YY(ByVal si As SessionInfo, ByVal WFTime As String) As String Try Return WFTime.Substring(2, 2) Catch ex As Exception Throw ErrorHandler.LogWrite(si, New XFException(si, ex)) End Try End Function
' Splits a pipe-delimited text property and returns the element at the given index. ' Parsed out of the app-local Parse_RP_Text_Property; nothing RP-specific about it. Public Shared Function ParseTextProperty(ByVal si As SessionInfo, ByVal Text As String, ByVal ReturnStringAtIndex As String) As String Try If Text = "" Then Return "" Return StringHelper.SplitString(Text, "|")(ReturnStringAtIndex) Catch ex As Exception Throw ErrorHandler.LogWrite(si, New XFException(si, ex)) End Try End Function
' Returns True when the current user should see the workflow read-only: ' - in the (app-supplied) auditor group and not an admin, OR ' - not in the active scenario's ReadWriteDataGroup. ' Parsed out of the app-local Is_Read_Only. The auditor group is passed in via ' auditorGroupParamName so no app-specific parameter name is baked into GBL. Public Shared Function Is_Read_Only(ByVal si As SessionInfo, ByVal auditorGroupParamName As String) As Boolean Try Dim grpAuditors As String = BRApi.Dashboards.Parameters.GetLiteralParameterValue(si, False, auditorGroupParamName)
Dim wfPk As WorkflowUnitPk = BRApi.Workflow.General.GetWorkflowUnitPk(si) Dim scenarioReadWriteGrpId As Guid = BRApi.Finance.Members.GetMemberInfo(si, dimTypeId.Scenario, wfPk.ScenarioKey, True).Member.ReadWriteDataGroupUniqueID Dim userInScenarioReadWriteGrp As Boolean = BRApi.Security.Authorization.IsUserInGroup(si, scenarioReadWriteGrpId)
If BRApi.Security.Authorization.IsUserInGroup(si, grpAuditors) And Not BRApi.Security.Authorization.IsUserInAdminGroup(si) Then Return True Else If Not userInScenarioReadWriteGrp Then Return True Else Return False End If Catch ex As Exception Throw ErrorHandler.LogWrite(si, New XFException(si, ex)) End Try End Function
#End Region
End Class End Namespace
